Fungal infection.advice: Antifungal cream or oral medication. Keep affected area dry.

GERD.advice: Avoid spicy/fatty food. Antacids. Elevate head while sleeping.

Chronic cholestasis.advice: Consult gastroenterologist. Liver function tests required.

Drug Reaction.advice: Stop suspected medication immediately. Seek medical attention.

Peptic ulcer disease.advice: Avoid NSAIDs. PPI medication. Test for H. pylori.

AIDS.advice: Immediate referral to infectious disease specialist. ART therapy.

Diabetes.advice: Monitor blood sugar. Low GI diet. Metformin if prescribed.

Gastroenteritis.advice: ORS rehydration. Bland diet. Antibiotics if bacterial.

Bronchial Asthma.advice: Use inhaler as prescribed. Avoid triggers. Nebulization if severe.

Hypertension.advice: Low sodium diet. Regular BP monitoring. Antihypertensives.

Migraine.advice: Rest in dark room. Triptans or OTC pain relief. Track triggers.

Cervical spondylosis.advice: Physiotherapy. Neck exercises. NSAIDs for pain.

Paralysis (brain hemorrhage).advice: EMERGENCY — Call ambulance immediately. Time-critical treatment.

Jaundice.advice: Liver function tests. Rest. High carb low fat diet.

Chicken pox.advice: Rest, calamine lotion, antiviral if severe. Avoid scratching.

Dengue.advice: No aspirin/ibuprofen. Monitor platelet count. IV fluids if severe.

Hepatitis A.advice: Rest. Avoid alcohol. High calorie diet. Usually self-limiting.

Hepatitis B.advice: Antiviral therapy. Avoid alcohol. Regular liver monitoring.

Hepatitis C.advice: Antiviral therapy (DAAs). Specialist referral. No alcohol.

Hepatitis E.advice: Rest. Supportive care. Avoid alcohol. Usually self-limiting.

Alcoholic hepatitis.advice: Stop alcohol immediately. Corticosteroids. Nutritional support.

Tuberculosis.advice: 6-month DOTS therapy. Isolation initially. Chest X-ray.

Common Cold.advice: Rest, fluids, vitamin C. OTC decongestants. Usually 7-10 days.

Pneumonia.advice: Antibiotics. Chest X-ray. Hospitalization if SpO2 < 94%.

Dimorphic hemorrhoids(piles).advice: High fibre diet. Sitz baths. Surgical if severe.

Heart attack.advice: EMERGENCY — Call ambulance. Aspirin 325mg. Do not drive yourself.

Varicose veins.advice: Compression stockings. Elevate legs. Surgery if severe.

Hyperthyroidism.advice: Antithyroid drugs. Beta-blockers for symptoms. Specialist referral.

Hypoglycemia.advice: Eat 15g fast sugar immediately. Recheck blood glucose after 15 min.

Osteoarthritis.advice: Physiotherapy. Weight loss. NSAIDs. Joint replacement if severe.

Vertigo.advice: Epley maneuver. Vestibular rehab. Antivertigo medication.

Acne.advice: Benzoyl peroxide. Retinoids. Avoid touching face. Dermatologist.

Urinary tract infection.advice: Antibiotics. Drink plenty of water. Cranberry juice.

Impetigo.advice: Topical or oral antibiotics. Keep area clean. Avoid contact.
